body:
Although I thoroughly remember this experience, it was some time ago, so some details may be more vague than others. However, i will do my absolute best to recollect the night as well as possible.
First of all, let me start by explaining that if you choose to smoke salvia, i severely recommend you make absolute sure you are in a safe location away from people or entities in which you find yourself uncomfortable. I learned this lesson the hard way. Allow me to explain.
I was at a party in a neighborhood nearby, at a house that was considered a frequent social location; I had shown up with my best friend, let's just call him P., and maybe another person or two, but I can't necessarily remember that detail.  After a couple of drinks in, my old friend who had recently been released from jail had shown up, let's call him D, with his girlfriend and a few others. At this point, the party was decently full of people, so me and a group of friends, about 9 others, had walked out onto the dock of the house we were at. I had heard some talk from D up at the house about trying salvia, and although I had heard much about the drug before, I had never actually tried it and was curious. I was a bit suspicious however, for I was one of the only few people that wanted to do it in that particular moment, but I considered the fact that the people around me were not as fond of psychedelic experiences as I was. The words that sold me was D telling me 'it will only last for 5 minutes'. And although he was correct, it was a choice I personally wish I had not made.
So there we were, a circle of 8 or 9 people sitting on a dock in the middle of the night (by the way, the dock had no railings on it whatsoever), and D proceeds to construct a water bottle pipe out of a wrench socket and a tiny
water bottle. I was the first to give it a go; so D whips out a little clear baggy with what appears to be little black shavings of a plant, an almost tobacco looking substance. He then packs it for me and states that he is going the light it and clear it for me, which immediately made me ease up a bit. I turn on some music, STRFKR-Khalil Gibran, and press the water bottle to my lips and start dragging.
Once pulling, clearing, and holding in the dry-tasting herbs, I heard D begin to count down from 10. As he started to count down, his voice got deeper with each number, until he got to 1. All of a sudden, I felt my head drop, and a series of red numbers started shooting across my line of vision. I am not too sure what exactly happened next; all I remember was feeling as if my conscious disappeared, I had almost immediately forgotten I had smoked salvia and assumed I was in a dream state. Because what happened next was absurd. My body felt as if it were on a roller coaster; everything around me melted into a completely different scene. I was now in an eerie forest surrounded not by trees, but surrounded by the people who were with me, who all were morphed into trees with evil looking faces.
I felt as if my mental slate was completely wiped clean, I had forgotten everything prior to smoking the salvia, and it had blasted me into another dimension almost immediately. It was completely bizarre. I remember feeling the deep dark realization that maybe this was it, maybe the world was ending around me, and there was nothing I could do to escape it. Naturally, I panicked and stood up out of my chair, completely unaware that this was reality or what the people around me were seeing. Once I stood up, the whole world started spinning, and I saw the group of 8 or 9 people approaching me, which freaked me the fuck out. At this point, the only thing that was going through my mind was that the entire world was essentially a twisted nightmare I couldn't escape from, and that the people around me had been plotting for this to happen and they now saw my vulnerability as an opportunity to kill me.

It was completely terrifying.
I started thrusting and fighting off everybody around me, and the more they tried to help me, the more I tried to escape because I thought they were out to get me. I was entirely convinced that reality was playing a sick game with me and that every thing around me, living and non-living, wanted me dead. I could not see straight, everything was spinning, vague, and blurry, and my body still had a rushing sensation as if I were sky diving. The only thing I can best compare it to is the craziness, disorder and the lack of sense that comes when you are in a dream state. What happened next still gives me the chills to this day, for I continue to thank my lucky stars I had a good friend with me on the dock.
In the midst of all of my panic and confusion trying to escape everybody who was holding me down (for my own safety), I caught a glimpse of the water off the side of the dock, and for some fucking reason, thought it would be the safest place to escape to where these evil entities around me could not get me.
My best friend used all of his strength to hold me back, which in itself was scaring the shit out of me, I had assumed it was not letting me escape because it wanted me dead. I grab hold of a wooden post on the side of the dock and thrust myself away from him, completely mid air over the water. In a split second, P reached over the side of the dock, and with one arm, grabbed me by the abdomen and threw me back on to the dock and held me down while I freaked out for a while. I remember leaning off the side of the dock and puking my lungs out, while at the same time hearing another eager consumer behind me go on about how excited he was to try it after seeing the show I just put on.
I was slowly starting to come back to reality, because I could make out faces again, I suddenly knew where I was, and the memory returned to me that I had in fact smoked salvia, which automatically made ten times more sense to me. All I was able to croak out of my mouth, in that moment, was 'Don't do it!' to my friend behind me who had wanted to try it. After what felt like ages, I sat up and looked around me, and the only person who was with me on the dock was P, with a joint rolled ready to smoke after such a crazy experience. I thanked him, and for the rest of the night I remember sitting in a rocking chair on the back porch, completely silent, green in the face, and motionless for about the rest of the night.
My conclusive thoughts about the whole thing were that had I not been in that particular context, with all of those people around me on a dock in the pitch black night, then I maybe would have had an excellent time with it. But being young and eager, I was definitely looking for a psychedelic rush at any turn, and I truly and honestly think my bad experience was my fault. However, the drug completely swept me off my feet; I cannot stress it enough when I explain that smoking this substance put me in another realm in which I was convinced I was not even alive anymore, there will never be any words that can amount to the peak rush I had experienced that night, it was a completely world-altering experience, and if there is a next time for such a drug, I will be much more prepared.
Thank you for reading and hope it helps at all.
